- Page 2 24/7 support, the TP-750C is the guaranteed gold standard for power. STANDARDS AND FEATURES The connectors and power specifications of the TP-750C PSU are all compatible with ATX12V v2.4 and EPS12V v2.92 specifications. The TP-750C features Universal Input, which automatically senses when you connect the power supply to any AC power source between 100 - 240V without setting a voltage switch. 
- Page 3 PLUS® certified power supply uses less energy and generates less heat to stay cooler, run quieter and last longer. The TP-750C has been 80 PLUS® GOLD certified to be at least 87% efficient at a wide range of operating loads; this will lower your operating costs and help protect the environment. 
- Page 4 TABLE 2 Cable Quantity Connectors +12V Rail Description +12V1 24(20+4)-pin Motherboard +12V1 8(4+4)-pin ATX12V/EPS12V +12V2 8(6+2)-pin PCI-E +12V1 Molex + FDD +12V1 SATA + Molex... 
- Page 5 INSTALLATION Install the PSU into either the top or bottom of your case with the four screws provided. Refer to your case manual if you are unsure where the power supply should be installed. Connect the 24-pin main power connector to your motherboard. Connect the 8-pin or 4+4-pin connector for the CPU. 
- Page 6 Connect the AC power cord to the power supply AC inlet. Be sure to use the heavy-duty cord supplied with your PSU. PCI-E graphics cards use different amounts of power. For some, a single 6-pin connector is sufficient, making the hardwired connector the preferred choice. More powerful cards use multiple connectors, including the advanced 8-pin PCI-E connector.

## Antec TP-550C Overview

The TruePower Classic TP-550C 550W Power Supply from Antec was built to comply with the toughest energy standard available, ErP Lot 6: 2013. The TP-550C is 80 PLUS GOLD certified and can operate at up to 92% efficiency. High Current Rails and a 98% +12V output ratio maximizes the TP-550C's capabilities to power high-performance processors and graphics cards.

The PhaseWave design is a server-class LLC design with a synchronous rectification based on a DC-DC topology. Japanese capacitors achieve tight voltage regulation for low ripple and noise, which can maximize your system's performance. Antec's intelligent Thermal Manager fan control spins the high-quality 120 mm double-ball-bearing fan to cool your TP-550C quietly and efficiently. CircuitShield makes the TP-550C safe and reliable with its eight industrial-grade protections.
